preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (deployer)
Contract must have users with token balances

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setMaxTxPercent(0) to set _maxTxAmount to zero. This will lock all user transfers (except owner transfers) because the _transfer function requires amount <= _maxTxAmount for non-owner senders/recipients. Users will be unable to transfer any tokens while the owner can still transfer freely.
